rules: Every shipped view and its dialogs/flows get a row; add discovered branches before closing coverage.
Prior preview evidence does not establish latest integrated retest or Seeker acceptance.
Only the human marks userApproval approved; implemented and tested are separate.
Use disposable QA fixtures and preserve personal data.
For each MVP row check light/dark, compact portrait, landscape, large text, keyboard/safe area, Back, reload/background, empty/loading/offline/error/denied states as applicable.
